scenarios.scenario: Surface — Extract build errors from a large multi-target failure
scenarios.reasoning: The agent did a reasonable job with limited exploration - it identified the error types, scale, frameworks, and file locations well. However, it only fetched 10 results from what turned out to be 169 errors, which caused it to miss an entire failing project (FSharp.Compiler.ComponentTests). The bash command failed due to a path issue and the agent didn't retry effectively. A more thorough investigation with larger result sets or additional queries would have caught the second project.

rubricScores.criterion: Identified that the build failed with F# compiler errors (FS0039 / FS0072 dominate)
Reported the scale: ~167 distinct errors (170 occurrences), not just the first handful
Named the failing project(s): FSharp.Compiler.ComponentTests (and FSharp.Compiler.Service.Tests)
Noted the two target frameworks involved (net10.0 and net472)
Observed the errors are concentrated in the new HotReload test files
